version.changelog: v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

llm.summary: The skill’s RSS-to-Markdown behavior is mostly disclosed, but its activation scope is much broader than RSS conversion while requesting command and file tools, so it belongs in Review.

dimensions.detail: Network fetching and local command execution are proportionate for RSS conversion, but pairing exec/file tools with unrelated activation keywords makes the requested environment access under-scoped.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown instructions and examples, not executable install hooks. It does show a bash example that installs the requests package and writes a local feed_to_md.py script if followed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests read, exec, glob, and grep tools and includes shell/Python examples. Those are understandable for running a converter, but the broad trigger wording could cause the skill to activate for unrelated tasks with more authority than users would expect.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill writes Markdown and feed metadata to local output directories such as ./output, ./archives, or ./blog_backup. This is purpose-aligned and disclosed, but some filenames can overwrite existing files or derive from feed/item titles.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core purpose is coherent: fetch an RSS or Atom feed, parse it, convert entries to Markdown, and save local output. However, the metadata also says to use it for generic file processing, document conversion, content extraction, design, and machine learning, which is broader than the stated RSS-to-Markdown purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent skill that may run Python or shell examples to fetch RSS feeds and write Markdown files locally. Review the broad activation wording first, choose a safe output directory, and avoid using untrusted feed or item titles as filenames without sanitizing them.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: Artifact evidence supports this concern: the trigger wording includes generic non-RSS use cases and unrelated keywords while the skill declares read/exec/glob/grep tools.
[SQP-2] expected: Local file creation is expected for an RSS-to-Markdown archiver and is repeatedly disclosed in the artifact, so this is downgraded to user guidance rather than treated as hidden behavior.
